# Flint Public API SDK

- [Quickstart](README.md): installation, required environment and calling convention.
- [API index](REFERENCE.md): select a resource, then read its operation.
- [Model index](MODELS.md): declared fields, variants and enums.
- [Runtime](RUNTIME.md): client/request options, credentials, retries, errors and recovery.

Read the index, one relevant resource, and the runtime guide first.
